topic: Choose a new team messaging platform for the department

scenario.topic: Choose a new team messaging platform for the department
scenario.opening_question: What matters most to us in a messaging platform: ease of use, integrations, cost, or security?

options.name: Slack Standard Plan
options.upside: Extensive third-party integrations and widely adopted interface
options.tradeoff: Message history limited to 90 days on this plan
options.concern: Some users find Slack distracting due to frequent notifications
options.best_for: teams prioritizing integrations and familiar UI

options.name: Microsoft Teams Business Basic
options.upside: Strong integration with Office 365 apps and generous storage
options.tradeoff: Interface can feel complex for users without Microsoft 365 experience
options.concern: Some features require additional Microsoft licenses
options.best_for: teams needing tight Office app integration and cloud storage

options.name: Discord Nitro Classic
options.upside: Excellent voice and video chat quality with persistent channels
options.tradeoff: Less traditional for business use, may lack some enterprise features
options.concern: Perceived as a gamer-focused platform, which might affect adoption
options.best_for: teams valuing voice communication and informal collaboration

options.name: Mattermost Team Edition Cloud
options.upside: Highly customizable with strong privacy controls and open-source roots
options.tradeoff: Smaller user base and fewer integrations compared to competitors
options.concern: Requires more setup effort and technical familiarity

shared_context: The department has exactly 3 members who will use the platform
The budget for the messaging platform subscription is capped at $15 per user per month
The goal is to improve team communication and collaboration without steep learning curves

personas.name: Juno
personas.background: Juno enjoys experimenting with new communication tools that foster informal collaboration and high-quality voice chat.
personas.private_goal: Juno cares most about excellent voice communication and persistent channels for team bonding.

agenda.reason: state one grounded reason for the initial preference
ask about a practical constraint that could affect the choice
compare the preferred option with a realistic alternative
look for a workable compromise the group could accept
